title: ContextWeaver: Selective and Dependency-Structured Memory Construction for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.23069v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents often struggle in long-context interactions. As the history grows, sliding windows and prompt compression may drop earlier information that later steps rely on. Retrieval-based memory systems surface relevant content but still overlook the causal and logical dependencies between steps. We introduce ContextWeaver, a selective and dependency-structured memory framework that organizes an agent's interaction trace into a graph of reasoning steps and selects the relevant context for future actions. ContextWeaver supports (1) dependency-based construction and traversal that link each step to the earlier steps it relies on; (2) compact dependency summaries of the reasoning paths; and (3) a lightweight validation layer that incorporates execution feedback. On five software-engineering and terminal benchmarks with a fixed budget per task, ContextWeaver improves the resolve rate over a sliding-window baseline

translated_title: ContextWeaver：面向大语言模型智能体的选择性、依赖结构化记忆构建方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在长上下文交互中常常表现不佳。随着历史记录的增长，滑动窗口和提示压缩可能会丢弃后续步骤所依赖的早期信息。基于检索的记忆系统能够呈现相关内容，但仍然忽略了步骤之间的因果和逻辑依赖关系。我们提出了ContextWeaver，这是一个选择性的、依赖结构化的记忆框架，它将智能体的交互轨迹组织成一个由推理步骤构成的图，并为未来的动作选择相关上下文。ContextWeaver支持：（1）基于依赖的构建与遍历，将每个步骤与其所依赖的早期步骤链接起来；（2）对推理路径进行紧凑的依赖摘要；（3）一个融合执行反馈的轻量级验证层。在五个软件工程和终端基准测试中，采用每任务固定预算，ContextWeaver相比滑动窗口基线提高了任务解决率。
tldr: ContextWeaver将智能体的交互轨迹组织成带依赖链接的推理步骤图，结合紧凑依赖摘要与执行反馈验证来选择性构建记忆上下文，从而在固定预算下显著提升LLM智能体在软件工程和终端长上下文任务中的解决率。
